correctness.rationale: For K_{m,n}, m,n>=2, graph-continuity means every vertex and edge inverse image is empty, singleton or an edge. Pure image in one part iff restrictions from each source part are partial injections; mixed image necessitates an injective bipartition-preserving or swapping map. Inclusion-exclusion on a fixed pure image set yields P_k; selecting mixed images yields M_k. A continuous section exists for mixed-image maps, whereas for pure image it exists iff one source part alone maps onto the image, giving R_k via inclusion-exclusion; idempotents are exactly maps fixing their image yielding E_k. Nonregular rank-two count 2mn[binom m2+binom n2].
